name: Idle
description: Tired, patient breathing with a small glance.

name: Happy
description: Soft crescent eyes, a pleased nod and open hands.

name: Excited
description: Anticipation squat, fist pump, two-foot hop and a soft landing.

name: Sad
description: Slow sag, drooping eyes and heavy arms.

name: Angry
description: Planted stance, clenched hands and a short foot stamp.

name: Confused
description: Alternating head tilts, raised brow and a questioning hand.

name: Searching
description: Hand above the screen, scanning gaze and a careful lean.

name: Sassy
description: Side-eye, raised palm and a dismissive wrist sweep.

name: EyeRoll
description: Look away, eyes sweep up, followed by a tired shrug.

name: RudeFlipOff
description: Anticipate, raise hand, extend finger, hold, retract and settle.

name: Wave
description: Open-palm wave with a relaxed return.

name: Revived
description: Straighten, smile, lift both palms and settle with relief.

name: WalkRight
description: Rightward foot-planted walking cycle; host travel is separate.

name: WalkLeft
description: Leftward foot-planted walking cycle, without mirroring the artwork.

name: Laugh
description: A contained chuckle builds into two laughs, then exhales. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Proud
description: Gather composure, lift the chest and present a quietly triumphant pose. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Shy
description: Look away, tuck the shoulders and bring the hands inward before peeking back. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Suspicious
description: A narrow-eyed double take with one raised brow and a cautious side lean. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Startled
description: A sharp intake, raised hands and recoil followed by a visible recovery. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Frustrated
description: Tension builds into two restrained shakes and a long settling sigh. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Sleepy
description: Heavy lids, two head nods and a soft fold into a held sleeping pose. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: WakeUp
description: Wake from the matching sleeping pose, stretch and regain focus. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Think
description: Search with the eyes, hold a chin-side thinking hand, then find an idea. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Facepalm
description: A slow realization, palm to the screen edge, held disbelief and release. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Shrug
description: Lift both shoulders, turn both palms out and settle after an asymmetric hold. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: PointLeft
description: Look left before extending a pointing hand, hold the cue, then retract. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: PointRight
description: Look right before extending a pointing hand, hold the cue, then retract. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Bow
description: Gather the hands, hinge into a respectful bow, pause and rise with follow-through. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Jump
description: Plant the feet, compress, launch into a tucked hop and land with a soft recovery. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: Land
description: A short descending arrival compresses through the knees and rebounds to rest. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: RunRight
description: A quick rightward running cycle with airborne feet, opposing arms and trailing cable. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.

name: RunLeft
description: A quick leftward running cycle with airborne feet, opposing arms and trailing cable. The screen hinge leads with a broad head tilt; hands stage the gesture and the hinge follows through.
